summary: Kustom Entertainment, Inc. (Buyer) filed an 8-K disclosing a Unit Purchase Agreement dated August 31, 2026 to acquire all equity interests of TFL, LLC from multiple sellers. Aggregate consideration is $89.6 million cash plus $22.4 million in restricted common stock, subject to adjustments, with $35.0 million of TFL debt repaid at closing. $1.5 million escrowed for adjustments and indemnification; $11.2 million held back as shares contingent on 2027 EBITDA target. Sellers get a board seat and registration rights. Closing subject to customary conditions; watch regulatory approvals and EBITDA earn-out.
